pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to weather_cli: what it does, how it works at a glance, key features, and how to navigate the wiki for deeper details.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Installation instructions (Homebrew tap and building from source), basic usage examples, and a quick-start guide for new users.

pages.title: Project History and Versioning
pages.purpose: Version history from v0.2.3 to v0.3.0, notable milestones (CLI spinner, forecast UI, automated release, Homebrew distribution), and the project's evolution.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Overview of the modular Rust architecture: how the five source modules (main, connectors, cache, depictors, response_layouts) fit together, the request lifecycle, and key design decisions. Links to child pages for each module.

pages.title: CLI Entry Point and Argument Parsing
pages.purpose: Detailed coverage of src/main.rs: the Args struct, all CLI flags (-a/-b, --ml, -i, -f, -c), the main() async function, routing logic, the calc_and_fetch pipeline, and the interactive_loop REPL.

pages.title: HTTP Connector and Data Fetching
pages.purpose: Deep dive into src/connectors.rs: the ReturnedData enum, the fetch() async function, URL template transformation via transform_url(), the tokio-based spinner polling loop, and the sequential deserialization strategy.

pages.title: Response Data Models
pages.purpose: Complete reference for src/response_layouts.rs: all serde-derived structs (WeatherResponse, WeatherDaily, Current, Daily, CurrentUnits, DailyUnits, Location), their fields, types, and how they map to the Open-Meteo API JSON schema.

pages.title: Caching System
pages.purpose: Full explanation of src/cache.rs: the WeatherCache type alias, CacheEntry<T> struct, TTL_SECONDS constant (300 minutes), cache_path() using the dirs crate, load_cache/save_cache/clear_cache functions, insert_save(), and is_valid() TTL validation logic.

pages.title: Terminal Output and Visualization
pages.purpose: Coverage of src/depictors.rs: pretty_print_weather() for current conditions, pretty_print_forecast() for the 7-day tabular view with zebra-striping, depict_forecast() for the ASCII time-temperature chart via textplots, and the colored crate usage.

pages.title: External API Integration
pages.purpose: Overview of the two external APIs used by weather_cli — Open-Meteo for weather data and ip-api.com for geolocation — including endpoint URLs, query parameters, and how responses map to internal data models.

pages.title: Open-Meteo Weather API
pages.purpose: Details of the Open-Meteo API endpoints used: the current weather endpoint (temperature_2m, wind_speed_10m, rain, snowfall, precipitation) and the 7-day forecast endpoint (uv_index_max, snowfall_sum, showers_sum, rain_sum, shortwave_radiation_sum, temperature_2m_mean, wind_speed_10m_max), including full URL templates with LAT/LON placeholders.

pages.title: IP Geolocation (MyLocation Feature)
pages.purpose: How the --ml flag works: the ip-api.com endpoint (http://ip-api.com/json?fields=lat,lon), the Location struct, caching of the 'ml' key, and how the resolved coordinates feed back into calc_and_fetch().

pages.title: Build, Release, and CI/CD
pages.purpose: Overview of the tooling and automation infrastructure: the justfile for local builds, GitHub Actions workflows for testing and releasing, and the CodeQL security scanning pipeline.

pages.title: Local Build Tooling (justfile)
pages.purpose: The justfile recipes: build (cargo build --release), strip (symbol removal with strip -S -x), buildStrip (bs alias), and release (rl alias for Homebrew tap synchronization). Covers the binary optimization profile (opt-level=z, lto=true) from Cargo.toml.

pages.title: GitHub Actions: Test and Release Workflow
pages.purpose: Detailed walkthrough of .github/workflows/test.yml: tag-triggered pipeline (v*), the build matrix (ubuntu/linux-x86_64 and macos/aarch64), cargo build, cargo test, binary prep (dist/ directory, strip), softprops/action-gh-release, LATEST_CHANGE.md as release notes, and webhook status dissemination via WEBHOOK_URL secret.

pages.title: GitHub Actions: CodeQL Security Analysis
pages.purpose: Coverage of .github/workflows/codeql.yml: triggers (push/PR to main/master, weekly schedule), the Rust CodeQL analysis job, and how it integrates with the project's quality control strategy.

pages.title: Dependency Reference
pages.purpose: Overview of all crate dependencies declared in Cargo.toml, their roles in the application, and notable feature flags. Links to relevant architecture pages.

pages.title: Core Runtime Dependencies
pages.purpose: Detailed coverage of tokio (async runtime, full features), reqwest (HTTP client, json feature), serde + serde_json (serialization/deserialization), and clap (CLI argument parsing with derive feature).

pages.title: UI and Utility Dependencies
pages.purpose: Coverage of colored (terminal text styling), textplots (ASCII chart rendering), rattles (CLI spinner/progress animation via presets::rain()), prompts (interactive TextPrompt), dirs (platform cache directory resolution), and tracing + tracing-subscriber (structured logging).

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of all codebase-specific terms, abbreviations, domain concepts, and Rust patterns used throughout weather_cli. Each entry includes file/function pointers for onboarding engineers.
